en.t: Bardas Phokas is defeated in the first battle associated with Pankaleia
en.s: A Byzantine army led by Bardas Phokas the Younger fought the rebel Bardas Skleros in Anatolia on a date reported as June 19, 978 by the early chronicler Yahya of Antioch. In a modern reconstruction of the disputed accounts, Phokas lost this first encounter; he defeated Skleros only in a later decisive battle in March 979. The accounts differ over the battles' sequence and exact sites.
en.n: June 19, 978 is the date reported for the first encounter in Yahya of Antioch's account; scholars dispute the precise site and sequence, and the later loyalist victory belongs to March 979.

zh.t: 巴尔达斯·福卡斯在与潘卡利亚相关的首场战斗中战败
zh.s: 按早期编年史家安条克的雅赫亚所记，978年6月19日，小巴尔达斯·福卡斯率领的拜占庭军队在安纳托利亚与叛军首领巴尔达斯·斯克莱罗斯交战。对有争议的古代记载，一种现代重建认为福卡斯在这场首战中失利，直到979年3月的决定性战役才击败斯克莱罗斯。各史料对战斗顺序和确切地点的说法并不一致。
zh.n: 978年6月19日是雅赫亚记载的首战日期；确切地点和战斗顺序仍有争议，福卡斯后来的胜利发生在979年3月。

en.s: The siege of Nicaea was the first major battle of the First Crusade, taking place from 14 May to 19 June 1097. The city was under the control of the Seljuk Turks who opted to surrender to the Byzantines in fear of the Crusaders breaking into the city. The siege was followed by the Battle of Dorylaeum and the Siege of Antioch, all taking place in modern Turkey.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 尼西亚围城战是第一次十字军东征的第一场主要战役，发生于1097年5月14日至6月19日。尼西亚当时由塞尔柱突厥人控制，他们担心十字军攻入城内，选择向拜占庭人投降。此后，十字军又在今土耳其境内参加多里莱乌姆战役和安条克围城战。
zh.n: 此条记录的是来源信息框所列的事件结束日期。

en.s: The War of the Galician Succession or War for the unification of the Principality of Galicia–Volhynia was a struggle for power over the Principality of Galicia–Volhynia. It took place from 19 June 1205 to 17 August 1245. The conflict was one of the longest wars of succession in Europe, and ended with the Romanovichi clan holding on to power.

zh.t: 加利西亚王位继承战争（1205—1245年）
zh.s: 加利西亚王位继承战争又称加利西亚—沃里尼亚公国统一战争，是围绕加利西亚—沃里尼亚公国统治权展开的斗争，发生于1205年6月19日至1245年8月17日。这是欧洲持续时间较长的王位继承战争之一，最终罗曼诺维奇家族继续掌权。

en.s: The Battle of Methven took place at Methven, Scotland on 19 June 1306, during the Wars of Scottish Independence. The battlefield is currently under research to be included in the Inventory of Historic Battlefields in Scotland and protected by Historic Scotland under the Scottish Historical Environment Policy of 2009.

zh.s: 梅思文战役于1306年6月19日在苏格兰梅思文发生，是苏格兰独立战争的一部分。目前，战场正在接受研究，可能被列入苏格兰历史战场名录，并根据2009年《苏格兰历史环境政策》受到苏格兰历史遗产部门保护。

zh.s: 1582年6月16日至19日，日本战国时期，织田氏与北条氏军队在上野国和武藏国交界地区交战。

en.s: The city of Bihać in the Kingdom of Croatia within the Habsburg monarchy was besieged and captured by the Ottoman Empire in June 1592. With the arrival of Hasan-paša Predojević as the Beylerbey of the Bosnia Eyalet in 1591, a period of peace established between Emperor Rudolf II and Sultan Murad III ended and the provincial Ottoman armies launched an offensive on Croatia.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1592年6月10日至19日，奥斯曼军队围攻哈布斯堡治下克罗地亚王国的比哈奇。守将因得不到援军且兵力不足，于19日投降。

en.s: The Battle of Sorel occurred on June 19, 1610, with Samuel de Champlain supported by the Kingdom of France and his allies, the Wyandot people, Algonquin people and Innu people fought against the Mohawk people in New France at present day Sorel-Tracy, Quebec. The forces of Champlain armed with the arquebus engaged and killed or captured nearly all of the Mohawks. The battle ended major hostilities with the Mohawks for twenty years. The Battle of Sorel was part of the Beaver Wars, which pitted the nations of the Iroquois confederation, led by the dominant Mohawks, against the Algonquian peoples of the Great Lakes region, supported by the Kingdom of France.

zh.s: 索雷尔战役发生于1610年6月19日，地点在新法兰西索雷尔-特雷西（今加拿大魁北克省）。萨缪尔·德·尚普兰得到法国王国及其盟友休伦人、阿尔冈昆人和因努人的支持，与莫霍克人交战。尚普兰一方装备火绳枪，杀死或俘虏了几乎所有莫霍克战士。这场战斗使双方大规模敌对行动停止了20年。索雷尔战役是海狸战争的一部分；这场战争中，由莫霍克人主导的易洛魁联盟与五大湖地区的阿尔冈昆民族交战，后者得到法国支持。

en.t: Battle of the Brig of Dee
en.s: The Battle of the Brig of Dee took place on 18–19 June 1639 at the Bridge of Dee in Scotland, and was the only serious military action of the First Bishops' War. It featured a Royalist force under James Gordon, 2nd Viscount Aboyne, opposed by Covenanters led by James Graham, 5th Earl of Montrose, and resulted in a Covenanter victory.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 迪河桥战役于1639年6月18日至19日在苏格兰迪河桥发生，是第一次主教战争期间唯一一场重大战斗。阿博因子爵詹姆斯·戈登率领王党军，对阵第五代蒙特罗斯伯爵詹姆斯·格雷厄姆率领的圣约派军队，最终圣约派获胜。
zh.n: 此条记录的是来源信息框所列的事件结束日期。

en.s: The Battle of Tecroghan also called of Ticroghan, was a minor battle of the Cromwellian conquest of Ireland that was fought on 19 June 1650 outside Tecroghan Fort in County Meath, Ireland. The fort was besieged by the Parliamentarians. A force of the Irish Royalist Alliance commanded by the Earl of Castlehaven attempted to relieve the siege.

zh.s: 特克罗汉战役又称蒂克罗汉战役，是克伦威尔征服爱尔兰期间的一场小规模战斗，于1650年6月19日在爱尔兰米斯郡特克罗汉堡外发生。议会军围攻该堡垒。卡斯尔黑文伯爵率领爱尔兰保王联盟部队试图解围。

en.s: The 1674 Polish–Lithuanian royal election was an election to decide on the new candidate for the Polish–Lithuanian throne. On November 10, 1673, Michael Korybut Wiśniowiecki, King of Poland and Grand Duke of Lithuania, suddenly died in Lwów. The Polish throne was vacant again, so another free election was necessary. As in 1669, the main candidates were French Duke Louis, Grand Condé, Philip William, Count Palatine of Neuburg (both supported by Louis XIV of France), and Charles V, Duke of Lorraine.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1674年波兰—立陶宛自由选举旨在选出新的波兰—立陶宛君主。1673年11月10日，波兰国王兼立陶宛大公米哈乌·科里布特·维希尼奥维茨基突然在利沃夫去世，王位再次空缺，因此必须举行自由选举。主要候选人包括得到法国国王路易十四支持的法国大孔代亲王、新堡伯爵菲利普·威廉和洛林公爵查理五世。

en.s: An earthquake occurred on June 19, 1718, in Tongwei County, Gansu Province, Qing dynasty, present-day China. The estimated surface wave magnitude (Ms) 7.5 earthquake was designated a maximum Modified Mercalli intensity of X (Extreme), causing tremendous damage and killing 73,000 people.

zh.s: 1718年6月19日，清朝甘肃省通渭县发生地震，地点在今中国境内。地震面波震级估计为7.5级，修订麦加利烈度最高达到X级（极强），造成严重破坏，73,000人死亡。

en.s: The Battle of Yeghevārd, also known as the Battle of Baghavard or Morad Tapeh or Arpachai or Echmiadzin, was the final major engagement of the Ottoman–Persian War of (1730–1735) where the principal Ottoman army in the Caucasus theatre under Koprulu Pasha's command was utterly destroyed by only the advance guard of Nader's army before the main Persian army could enter into the fray.

zh.s: 1735年6月19日，奥斯曼—波斯战争期间，纳迪尔率领的波斯军队在今亚美尼亚叶格瓦尔德附近击败奥斯曼军队。这是该战争最后一场主要会战。

en.s: The siege of Tournai was a two-month siege of the city and citadel of Tournai, then part of the Austrian Netherlands, in 1745 during the War of the Austrian Succession. The allied Pragmatic Army's attempt to relieve the siege resulted in the decisive French victory at the Battle of Fontenoy on 11 May. The largely Dutch garrison of the city subsequently surrendered to French forces on 22 May, while the garrison of the citadel surrendered on 19 June 1745.

zh.s: 图尔奈围城战是1745年奥地利王位继承战争期间的一场围城战，持续两个月，围攻的是当时属于奥属尼德兰的图尔奈城及其城堡。盟军“务实军”试图解围，但在5月11日的丰特努瓦战役中被法军决定性击败。城市中以荷兰军队为主的守军随后于5月22日向法军投降，城堡守军则于1745年6月19日投降。

en.t: Nathanael Greene withdraws from Ninety Six after a failed siege
en.s: American commander Nathanael Greene withdrew his troops from Ninety Six, South Carolina, on June 19, 1781, after an unsuccessful assault on the Loyalist-held Star Fort the previous day. The withdrawal ended his attempt to capture the post during the American Revolutionary War. The fort remained in Loyalist hands at that point.
en.n: The final assault and decision to end the siege were on June 18; Greene's troops left Ninety Six on June 19.

zh.t: 格林攻打九十六镇失利后撤军
zh.s: 1781年6月19日，美国独立战争中的大陆军将领纳撒内尔·格林率军撤离南卡罗来纳的九十六镇。前一天，他们攻打效忠英国一方据守的星堡未果；这次撤军结束了格林夺取该据点的尝试。此时星堡仍由效忠英国一方控制。
zh.n: 最后一次攻堡和结束围城的决定发生在6月18日；格林的部队于6月19日离开九十六镇。

en.t: Boston's King's Chapel adopts James Freeman's revised prayer book
en.s: King's Chapel in Boston adopted the prayer book revised by its minister James Freeman on June 19, 1785. The changes removed Trinitarian language, including the Nicene and Athanasian Creeds, from the Anglican liturgy. The congregation has continued to use its own Unitarian form of the Book of Common Prayer.
en.n: June 19 is the congregation's adoption of the revised prayer book, not the date Freeman began his ministry.

zh.t: 波士顿国王礼拜堂采用弗里曼修订的祈祷书
zh.s: 1785年6月19日，波士顿国王礼拜堂采用牧师詹姆斯·弗里曼修订的祈祷书。修订版删去了英国国教礼仪中表达三位一体教义的内容，包括《尼西亚信经》和《亚他那修信经》。此后，该堂一直使用自己的一位论派版本《公祷书》。
zh.n: 6月19日是会众采用修订版祈祷书的日期，并非弗里曼开始担任牧师的日期。

en.s: The Dutch–Selangor war also known as Perang Satu Malam (One Night War), was a conflict over a fort in Bukit Malawati. The Dutch saw this as an opportunity to attack Selangor as a response to Selangor's raids on Dutch Malacca. This enraged Sultan Ibrahim of Selangor who was still governing the sultanate. Both countries signed a peace treaty, which later improved relations.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1784年至1786年，荷兰殖民军与雪兰莪苏丹国围绕马拉瓦蒂山堡垒交战。原文资料框将1786年6月19日列为战争结束日期，双方随后签订和平条约。

en.s: The Battle of Kircheib (German: Schlacht bei Kircheib) was a military engagement during the War of the First Coalition. On 19 June 1796, French and Austrian troops clashed at Kircheib in the Westerwald uplands in present-day Germany. The village the Austrians occupied was well defended and had cannons on the hills behind for additional protection.

zh.s: 基尔凯布战役（德语：Schlacht bei Kircheib）是第一次反法同盟战争期间的一次军事交战。1796年6月19日，法军和奥地利军队在今德国韦斯特林山地的基尔凯布交战。奥军占据的村庄防守严密，后方山丘上还部署了大炮作为支援。

en.s: The Battle of the Big Cross was a military engagement of the Irish Rebellion of 1798 between a force of United Irishmen rebels and a column of government troops. It was fought on 19 June 1798 on a spot on the Shannonvale-Ballinascarty road known locally as the "Big Cross", approximately four miles east of Clonakilty in West Cork. It was the only battle fought in the rebellion in County Cork.

zh.s: 大十字路口战役是1798年爱尔兰起义期间的一场军事交战，交战双方为联合爱尔兰人起义军和政府军纵队。战斗于1798年6月19日在西科克郡克朗纳基蒂以东约四英里的香农维尔—巴利纳斯卡蒂路上发生，地点当地称为“大十字路口”。这是科克郡在这场起义中发生的唯一一场战斗。

en.s: The battle of Ovidstown was a military engagement between British Crown forces and United Irishmen rebels during the Irish Rebellion of 1798 near the town of Kilcock, County Kildare. Despite the initial failures experienced by the United Irishmen in County Kildare during the first months of the rebellion, the consolidation of government forces in the town of Naas and the priority given by the Dublin Castle administration to suppress the Wexford Rebellion in County Wexford meant that much of the county remained in rebel hands since the outbreak of the rebellion.

zh.s: 奥维兹敦战役是1798年爱尔兰起义期间英国王室军队与爱尔兰联合会叛军在基尔代尔郡基尔科克附近的一次交战。起义初期，爱尔兰联合会在基尔代尔郡连遭失利；但政府军集中驻守纳斯镇，且都柏林政府优先镇压韦克斯福德郡起义，使该郡许多地区自起义爆发以来仍由叛军控制。

en.s: The Battle of Höchstädt was fought on 19 June 1800 on the north bank of the Danube near Höchstädt, and resulted in a French victory under General Jean Victor Marie Moreau against the Austrians under Baron Pál Kray. The Austrians were subsequently forced back into the fortress town of Ulm. Instead of attacking the heavily fortified, walled city, which would result in massive losses of personnel and time, Moreau dislodged Kray's supporting forces defending the Danube passage further east.

zh.s: 赫希施泰特战役于1800年6月19日在多瑙河北岸、赫希施泰特附近爆发。让-维克托·马里·莫罗将军率领法军击败保罗·克雷男爵指挥的奥军。奥军随后被迫退入乌尔姆要塞城。莫罗没有攻打防御坚固的城墙城市，以免造成重大人员伤亡并耽误时间，而是先击退了在更东面防守多瑙河通道、支援克雷的部队。

en.t: The Carlton House Fête is held in London to celebrate the establishment of the Regency era
en.s: The Carlton House Fête was hosted on 19 June 1811 by the Prince Regent, the future George IV, at his London residence Carlton House. Ostensibly held to honour the exiled Louis XVIII and French royal family, it functioned as a celebration of the establishment of George as Regent on behalf of his father George III. The lavish event set the tone amongst High Society during the Regency era.

zh.s: 摄政王、后来的乔治四世于1811年6月19日在伦敦住所卡尔顿宫举办卡尔顿宫庆典。名义上，庆典是为了向流亡的路易十八和法国王室致意，实际上则是为纪念乔治代表父亲乔治三世出任摄政王。这个奢华活动为摄政时期上流社会的社交风尚定下基调。

en.s: The Battle of Pequereque was a clash which took place on 19 June 1813, during the second Upper Peru campaign of the Argentine War of Independence, between scouting forces of the United Provinces Army of the North and the royalist Army of Peru. The republican cavalry of the Army of the North, led by Colonel Cornelio Zelaya, prevailed over the royalists, under the command of Colonel Pedro Olañeta.

zh.s: 佩克雷克战役是1813年6月19日发生的一场交战，属于阿根廷独立战争期间第二次上秘鲁战役的一部分。交战双方是北方联合省军和秘鲁保王军的侦察部队。科尔内利奥·塞拉亚上校率领的共和派骑兵击败了佩德罗·奥拉涅塔上校指挥的保王军。

en.s: The Battle of Cape Palos was the last battle of the Second Barbary War. The battle began when an American squadron under Commodore Stephen Decatur Jr. attacked and captured an Algerian brig.

en.s: The Second Barbary War, also known as the U.S.–Algerian War and the Algerine War, was a brief military conflict between the United States and the North African state of Algiers in 1815. Piracy had been rampant along the North African "Barbary" coast of the Mediterranean Sea since the 16th century.

zh.s: 1815年6月17日至19日，美国与北非阿尔及尔之间爆发短暂军事冲突，以遏制巴巴里海岸的海盗活动。

en.s: The Battle of Wavre was the final major military action of the Hundred Days campaign and the Napoleonic Wars. It was fought on 18–19 June 1815 between the Prussian rearguard, consisting of the Prussian III Corps under the command of General Johann von Thielmann (whose chief-of-staff was Carl von Clausewitz) and three corps of the French army under the command of Marshal Grouchy.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 瓦夫尔战役是百日王朝战役和拿破仑战争期间最后一场主要军事行动，发生于1815年6月18日至19日。交战双方是约翰·冯·蒂尔曼将军指挥的普鲁士第三军（参谋长为卡尔·冯·克劳塞维茨），以及格鲁希元帅率领的法军三个军团。

en.s: The Battle of Seven Oaks—also known as the Seven Oaks Massacre and the Seven Oaks Incident—was a violent confrontation of the Pemmican War between the Hudson's Bay Company (HBC) and the North West Company (NWC) which occurred on 19 June 1816 near modern-day Winnipeg, Manitoba. Resulting in a decisive victory for the NWC over their rivals in the North American fur trade, the confrontation was the climax in a long series of dispute in the Canadas. The battle is also known as the Victory of the Frog Plain (French: la Victoire de la Grenouillère) among Métis People, whose members fought for the NWC during the battle.

zh.s: 七橡树战役又称七橡树大屠杀或七橡树事件，是1816年6月19日在今加拿大曼尼托巴省温尼伯附近发生的一场暴力冲突，属于佩米坎战争的一部分。交战双方是哈德逊湾公司和西北公司。西北公司在北美毛皮贸易竞争中取得决定性胜利，这场冲突也使加拿大地区长期争端达到高潮。梅蒂人也称之为“青蛙平原的胜利”（法语：la Victoire de la Grenouillère）；他们在战斗中站在西北公司一方。

en.s: Karol Szymanowski's opera King Roger had its world premiere on June 19, 1926, at the Grand Theatre in Warsaw, Poland. en.s: The 1945 El Teniente mining accident, known locally as the Smoke Tragedy (Spanish: La tragedia del humo) is the biggest metallic mining accident in the history of Chile. en.s: An indirect election for the position of President of the Hellenic Republic was held by the Hellenic Parliament on 19 June 1975. Following the restoration of democracy in Greece, the distinguished jurist Michail Stasinopoulos was elected as the first, but provisional, President of the Third Hellenic Republic on 18 December 1974. With the entry into force of a new constitution in 1975 and the finalization of the new political framework, elections were held for the first regular President of the Republic. The ruling conservative New Democracy, which had 215 MPs, supported conservative politician Konstantinos Tsatsos, while the second-largest party, Centre Union – New Forces, proposed another conservative politician and former Prime Minister of Greece, Panagiotis Kanellopoulos.

en.s: General elections were held in Mali on 19 June 1979. They followed a 1974 referendum that approved a new constitution allowing for the direct election of the President for the first time. The country was a one-party state at the time, with the Democratic Union of the Malian People (UDPM) as the sole legal party. Its leader, Moussa Traoré, who had overthrown Modibo Keïta in 1968, was the only presidential candidate, and was elected unopposed. In the National Assembly elections several UDPM candidates were able to contest each seat, with 44% of the incumbent MPs defeated. Voter turnout was reported to be 97%.

en.s: The 1979 South African presidential election pitted the President of the South African Senate Marais Viljoen, backed by the ruling National Party, against the former United Party leader De Villiers Graaff, backed by the New Republic Party, and the Deputy Chancellor of the University of the Witwatersrand, Guerino Bozzoli, supported by the Progressive Federal Party. In accordance with the South African Constitution of 1961, the State President, a largely ceremonial post, was elected by a joint sitting of both houses of the South African Parliament. Both Bozzoli and Graaff had already been candidates for the presidential election of September 1978. The election, following the resignation of State President and former Prime Minister B. J. Vorster less than a year after his election, was won by Marais Viljoen, who had been Acting State President in his capacity as President of the Senate since June 4. The National Party had nominated Viljoen, rather than Transport Minister Lourens Muller, as its candidate on June 14. A joint session both houses of parliament voted along party lines on June 19, 1979, after which Viljoen was sworn in 90 minutes after his election.

en.s: The 2005 United States Grand Prix was one of the most controversial Formula One motor races in modern history. It was held on June 19, 2005 at the Indianapolis Motor Speedway and was the ninth race of the 2005 Formula One season. Out of the 20 cars that entered for the race, only the six cars from the teams using Bridgestone tyres (Ferrari, Jordan and Minardi) competed. The remaining fourteen entrants, all using Michelin tyres, completed the parade lap (thus having technically taken part in the race, avoiding punishment), but retired to the pits before the race started.

zh.s: 2005年美国大奖赛是现代一级方程式赛车史上最具争议的比赛之一。比赛于2005年6月19日在印第安纳波利斯赛车场举行，是该赛季第九站。参赛的20辆赛车中，只有使用普利司通轮胎的六辆赛车参加了比赛，车队分别为法拉利、乔丹和米纳尔迪。其余14辆赛车都使用米其林轮胎，完成暖胎圈后（因此从技术上说已参加比赛，避免受到处罚），便在比赛开始前退回维修区。

en.s: The al-Khilani mosque bombing occurred on 19 June 2007 when a truck bomb exploded in front of the Shia Al-Khilani Mosque in Baghdad, Iraq. At least 78 people were killed and another 218 injured in the blast. The explosion occurred just two days after a four-day curfew banning vehicle movement in the city was lifted after the al-Askari Mosque bombing (2007), and just hours after 10,000 US troops began the Arrowhead Ripper offensive to the north of Baghdad. Because the site was a Shia mosque, the bombing is presumed to have been the work of Sunnis.

zh.s: 2007年6月19日，一辆卡车炸弹在伊拉克巴格达什叶派卡赫拉尼清真寺门前爆炸，至少78人死亡、218人受伤。爆炸发生在阿斯卡里清真寺爆炸案后，巴格达解除为期四天的车辆禁行宵禁仅两天后；此前数小时，1万名美军刚在巴格达北部启动“箭头撕裂者”攻势。由于袭击目标是什叶派清真寺，外界推测袭击者是逊尼派武装。

en.s: The Battle of Point Pedro was fought on June 19, 2007 off Point Pedro during Eelam War IV, the final state of the Sri Lankan civil war. Several Sri Lankan Navy patrol boats were attacked by 24 patrol boats of the Liberation Tigers of Tamil Eelam's (LTTE) Sea Tigers, but with the help of Mil Mi-24 gunships of the Sri Lanka Air Force the attackers were driven off with the purported loss of 9 patrol boats and 40 LTTE members.

zh.s: 佩德罗角海战于2007年6月19日在佩德罗角近海爆发，是斯里兰卡内战最后阶段“伊拉姆战争IV”的一部分。泰米尔伊拉姆猛虎解放组织海虎部队出动24艘巡逻艇，袭击斯里兰卡海军的数艘巡逻艇；在斯里兰卡空军Mi-24武装直升机支援下，袭击者被击退。据称，9艘巡逻艇和40名猛虎组织成员在战斗中损失。

en.s: Operation Panchai Palang, or Panther's Claw, was a coalition military operation of the War in Afghanistan in Helmand Province in southern Afghanistan. The commander of the operation declared the first stage a success on 27 July 2009.

en.s: A regional election was held in Andalusia on 19 June 2022 to elect the 12th Parliament of the autonomous community. All 109 seats in the Parliament were up for election. en.s: Presidential elections were held in Colombia on 29 May 2022, with a runoff on 19 June 2022 as no candidate obtained at least 50% in the first round of voting.
